name: IntentParser detects loot intent
description: Checks that natural pickup phrasing becomes loot intent.

steps.text: I pick up the rusted iron key.

whyItMatters: If input intent is wrong, later inventory and consequence systems start from bad assumptions.

name: IntentParser detects travel intent
description: Checks that natural travel phrasing becomes travel intent and destination is extracted.

steps.text: I head to the ruined chapel before sunset.

whyItMatters: Travel intent affects scene and time systems. Wrong intent can cause scene jumps or missed route timing.
patchHint: Inspect IntentParser travel scoring and extractDestination.

name: IntentParser detects quoted speech as talk
description: Checks that quoted speech is treated as social/talk input.

steps.text: I ask Mira, "What did you see?"

whyItMatters: Actor and reputation logic often depends on recognizing speech instead of generic interaction.
patchHint: Inspect IntentParser speech scoring and tag generation.
